items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: he and Pee Wee Russell were very good friends... I think he made some records... with Pee Wee Russell

ctx.x: I was going to ask you about that, he did hang around with those --

Yeah, before he went into Cafe Society he was very popular in the Village, he worked at a place -- Nick's in the Village, it was quite a musicians hangout and he and Pee Wee Russell were very good friends. I think he made some records, probably a set of 78's and an album with Pee Wee Russell which I don't have at the present time. This was before, you know, cliff and I got together. But there are some photos around the house that were taken during the session, but I don't happen to have a copy of that album.
